items.context: Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) — Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output Vulnerability
items.notes: Synology DSM contains an improper encoding or escaping of output vulnerability in the system plugin daemon in Synology BeeStation OS (BSM) that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via unspecified vectors.

items.context: BerriAI LiteLLM — BerriAI LiteLLM Unprotected Alternate Channel Vulnerability
items.notes: BerriAI LiteLLM contains an unprotected alternate channel vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via bytecode rewriting at the /guardrails/test_custom_code URI.

items.context: Apache Axis — Apache Axis Unsafe Reflection Vulnerability
items.notes: Apache Axis contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via a crafted SOAP fault message that causes Axis to load and instantiate an attacker-specified class when a suitable class is available on the application classpath.
